content.NATO:
‭Speech:‬
‭The North Atlantic Treaty Organization is a global threat to peace and security, and they now have clear‬
‭pathways to implementing AI-enabled weapon systems, specifically Lethal Autonomous Weapons‬
‭Systems, known as LAWS. This means that the United Nations shouldn’t impose additional restrictions‬
‭on the deployment of these systems for defensive purposes because they are what will protect us from‬
‭these dangerous global aggressors. The Democratic People’s Republic of Korea’s resolution on this topic‬
‭further emphasizes this crucial point by establishing a review board to ensure the safe deployment of‬
‭LAWS for purely defensive applications. By monitoring these automated weaponry systems, we can‬
‭reduce civilian casualties and infrastructure damage while increasing our defensive capabilities to protect‬
‭against imminent threats. Additionally, by helping nations adapt their systems to reduce casualties, we can‬
‭improve the security of all countries. I urge all nations to endorse this resolution as it ensures that a state’s‬
‭fundamental right to defense is protected using modern artificial intelligence technology.‬
‭Additional Notes and Ideas:‬
‭Speech:‬
‭500,000 dead, and another 22 million displaced. You may initially think I’m referring to a world war or a‬
‭global pandemic, but you would be mistaken. Instead, these tragedies all occurred in one country, Syria,‬
‭because of hostile rebel groups. A plethora of nations have supplied these catastrophic rebel groups with‬
‭weapons, soldiers, and training. Although these nations must be held accountable, the objective of this‬
‭resolution is not to do this; instead, this resolution is for the people of Syria. These tragedies have‬
‭occurred for far too long, so it’s time that we implement a viable framework to disarm these rebel groups‬
‭and restore peace to the nation. By effectively halting the inflow of arms to any rebel groups in Syria and‬
‭by establishing neutral zones that will disarm the rebel groups with existing weapons, we will effectively‬
‭end the Syrian Civil War. and restore order to the region. Whether you have supplied arms to these rebel‬
‭groups in the past or simply feel compelled to aid the desperate people of Syria, I strongly urge you to‬
‭stand with the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea and support this thorough resolution.‬
‭Additional Notes and Ideas:‬
